spotCandleCSVs.note: Real spot OHLC — usable for directional strategy indicator computation. Cannot price option P&L without real snapshot data.

optionChainSnapshot.reason: No ingestion has ever run (option_chain_snapshot_run = 0 rows). The snapshot table is completely empty. Real option premium data does not exist for any index or any date. This prevents chronological out-of-sample backtesting with real premiums.

ivHistory.dataType: Daily ATM IV aggregate only (not per-contract premiums)
ivHistory.note: Daily ATM IV history from 2026-05-05. Useful for regime context but cannot substitute for actual option premiums.

backtestRuns.note: 81 historical backtest runs exist. DIRECTIONAL mode uses the delta-proxy (labeled MODELLED_DIRECTIONAL_PROXY). REAL_REPLAY mode requires option_chain_snapshot which is empty — all REAL_REPLAY runs would have returned UNAVAILABLE premiums.

dataQualityGates.noSyntheticPremiums: PASS — system never fabricates premiums; UNAVAILABLE returned when missing
dataQualityGates.noInterpolation: PASS — no interpolation path exists in premiumReplay.ts
dataQualityGates.nofutureLookhead: PASS — snapshot fetcher uses AT_OR_BEFORE constraint
dataQualityGates.noSameBarSignalFill: PASS — next-eligible-quote fill policy enforced (5-min tolerance)
dataQualityGates.noZeroPriceFallback: PASS — zero LTP rejected in resolvePremiumFromRow
dataQualityGates.excludedOutcomesCounted: PASS — UNAVAILABLE trades counted and disclosed
dataQualityGates.spreadLegSynchronized: N/A — no multi-leg snapshot data exists
dataQualityGates.noSurvivorshipBias: PASS — candle CSVs contain full index history; no look-forward selection

remediationPlan.step1: Activate option_chain_snapshot ingestion (5-min interval, NIFTY+BANKNIFTY+SENSEX, current+next expiry)
remediationPlan.step2: Run continuously for a minimum of 6 months to build sufficient history
remediationPlan.step3: After 6 months: re-run Gate 1 audit to verify coverage ≥ 60% per session
remediationPlan.step4: After coverage confirmed: re-execute Gates 2–10 with the frozen protocol
remediationPlan.minimumRequiredHistory: 6 months of snapshot coverage across all three indices for a 3-fold walk-forward
